title: Fernando: 40 minutes away
premise: Jennifer asks if Fernando is free this weekend. He replies with an enormous romantic future instead of driving the forty minutes to her house.
absurd_bits: he builds a house nobody lives in, with a porch
he imagines the children, a dog called Bruno who does not exist, a poem of eleven pages
he climbs an electricity pylon with his shirt off
the car flies the last stretch and lands at her door
her_voice: warm, dry, a little tired, talking to someone she loves who is being ridiculous
his_voice: grave, sincere, deadpan, a man narrating his own epic romance with total conviction
